title: Kinetic content manifest
description: The manifest.json of a Kinetic content folder. See docs/content-format.md for semantics.

items.description: an empty items array is valid: it is an honestly-empty folder (no visual of the sliced flow resolved to a file), and the player shows its no-content state for it (docs/extracting.md BUG 1)

branches.description: optional table of branch decisions over the item array; a decision fires on the forward settle of its `after` item and offers 2..N contiguous route spans; see docs/content-format.md § Branches

id.description: decision id; unique across branches and distinct from every item id, which the validator enforces

after.description: item id the decision fires on: when this item settles (forward), the overlay opens; must resolve to an item id, which the validator enforces

prompt.description: question shown above the route list; the validator caps its length

continuingRoute.description: id of the one route that continues the story; it must name a route of this decision and require continueAt, which the validator enforces

continueAt.description: item id where the continuing route proceeds after its end; allowed only with continuingRoute and must resolve to an item after every route end, which the validator enforces

id.description: route id; unique within its decision, which the validator enforces

label.description: text shown in the route list; the validator caps its length

start.description: first item of the route's inclusive contiguous span; must resolve to an item id at or before `end`, after the decision's `after` item, which the validator enforces

end.description: last item of the route's span; must resolve to an item id

result.description: what happens when the route ends: "ending" means its last item IS the ending (no implicit join); "return" needs the decision's continuingRoute and offers return-to-main via continueAt; default "ending"

path.description: a media file's path relative to the content folder root, forward-slash separated. Every segment is [A-Za-z0-9._-] and starts with a letter or digit, so there are no empty or dot-leading segments, no "..", no absolute path, no backslash, no drive letter or URL scheme, and no whitespace. Subfolders (typically a deterministic bucket like `assets/ab/`) are allowed and optional; the last segment is still a flat file name — an id-shaped stem, at most one derivative suffix (`.fNNN`, `.poster`, `.thumb`), then the extension. `imagePath` and `videoPath` add the true-format extension whitelist.

thought.description: true marks text as the speaker's unspoken thought rather than spoken dialogue; requires a non-empty text, which the validator enforces
true marks text as the speaker's unspoken thought rather than spoken dialogue; requires a non-empty text, which the validator enforces

startSeconds.description: playback range start in exact fractional seconds, never rounded; default 0; endSeconds > startSeconds and endSeconds <= durationSeconds are cross-field rules the validator enforces (docs/content-format.md, Video playback ranges)

endSeconds.description: playback range end in exact fractional seconds, never rounded; default durationSeconds; endSeconds > startSeconds and endSeconds <= durationSeconds are cross-field rules the validator enforces (docs/content-format.md, Video playback ranges)

loopStartSeconds.description: loop restart point in exact fractional seconds, never rounded; default startSeconds, so only the first pass plays the pre-roll; must be less than the effective end (endSeconds if present, else durationSeconds), a cross-field rule the validator enforces (docs/content-format.md, Video playback ranges)

loopCount.description: times the video plays before auto-advance; default 1

holdSeconds.description: explicit display duration; when present the media gate is time driven and ended is ignored (docs/content-format.md, Timing)

minPlaySeconds.description: floor for chain-exit timing: in auto mode the player waits at the end of the video's dialogue chain until minPlaySeconds have elapsed since the chain's video item became current; manual advance and skip stay immediate; outside chains it has no effect beyond the media gate (docs/content-format.md, Timing)
